data.title: The Cove
data.about:
Watch as the sun sets on the most exquisite views of Downtown Dubai, The Tower and the Ras Al Khor Sanctuary, only at The Cove.

Nestled in Dubai Creek Harbour, The Cove offers you a choice of 1, 2, 3 bedroom apartments, with the most breath-taking views. Waterfront homes, The Cove offers an unparalleled lifestyle to its residents.You will have access to the best amenities like the yacht club, boardwalk, lush pathways, promenades, parks and more. Dubai Creek Harbour is where tranquility is located. Come and find yours, here.
